parameters.name: base_path
parameters.description: File path prefix associated with the filesystem.

parameters.name: partition_label
parameters.description:
Optional, label of SPIFFS partition to use. If set to null, first
  partition with subtype=spiffs will be used.

parameters.name: max_files
parameters.description: Maximum files that could be open at the same time.

parameters.name: format_if_mount_failed
parameters.description: If true, it will format the file system if it fails to mount.

documentation.description: Register and mount SPIFFS to VFS with given path prefix.
documentation.returns:
- `ESP_OK` if SPIFFS was registered successfully
  - `ESP_ERR_NO_MEM` if objects could not be allocated
  - `ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE` if already mounted or partition is
    encrypted
  - `ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND` if partition for SPIFFS was not found
  - `ESP_FAIL` if mount or format fails

documentation.description: Register and mount SPIFFS to VFS with given path prefix.

parameters.name: conf
parameters.description:
Configuration structure
@raise ESPIDF_Error raised on error:
  - `ESP_ERR_NO_MEM` if objects could not be allocated
  - `ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE` if already mounted or partition is
    encrypted
  - `ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND` if partition for SPIFFS was not found
  - `ESP_FAIL` if mount or format fails
